examples.note: Abidjan — 27 is the fixed-line prefix, 21 the Abidjan area code

notes: Côte d'Ivoire renumbered on 2021-01-31, going from 8 to 10 digits by prepending two digits that encode service and carrier (27 fixed, 01/05/07 mobile).
Mobile numbers therefore begin with a 0 (01, 05, 07), but that leading 0 is part of the number rather than a trunk prefix — it is kept when dialling from abroad, as in +225 07 12 34 56 78.
An earlier expansion from 6 to 8 digits took place on 2000-01-15.
There is no trunk prefix — the full 10 digits are dialled for every domestic call.
sources: ARTCI — Autorité de Régulation des Télécommunications de Côte d'Ivoire: https://www.artci.ci/
